tos.contentMarkdown:
• **Docito® is a registered trademark/brand of Artsy Developers Inc.**

• **No claim of HIPAA compliance** (we use safe language: “privacy-first / security-focused / HIPAA-aligned practices” and “BAA support may be available upon request” only as an option).
• Covers Docito’s features/roles: care seekers, providers, clinics/practices, labs, imaging, pharmacies, staff, admin/super-admin; bookings, referrals, messaging, records/files/notes, payments, analytics, verification, insurance info, specialty-based UI.

These Terms of Service (“**Terms**”) govern your access to and use of the Docito® platform, including our websites, applications, dashboards, and related services (collectively, the “**Services**” or “**Docito**”). Docito® is a registered trademark/brand of **Artsy Developers Inc.** (“**Artsy Developers**,” “**we**,” “**us**,” “**our**”).

By creating an account, accessing, or using the Services, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use Docito.

---

## 1) Who Docito Is For

Docito supports multiple roles, including:

• **Care Seekers** (people seeking healthcare services),
• **Providers** (doctors, dentists, specialists, and other licensed healthcare professionals),
• **Facilities** (clinics/practices, laboratories, imaging centers, pharmacies, and similar healthcare organizations),
• **Staff** (team members invited by Providers/Facilities),
• **Admins/Super-Admins** (users managing platform configuration, verification, and monitoring).

---

## 2) Definitions

• **“Care Seeker”** means a user seeking healthcare services or information.
• **“Provider”** means a licensed healthcare professional who offers services through Docito.
• **“Facility”** means a healthcare organization (clinic/practice/lab/imaging center/pharmacy/hospital or similar) using Docito.
• **“Staff”** means any user invited by a Provider or Facility and assigned role-based permissions.
• **“Booking”** means an appointment request, service request, booking, referral appointment request, or scheduling action made through Docito.
• **“Content”** means any data or material uploaded, entered, posted, sent, stored, or generated through the Services (including messages, files, notes, templates, listings, schedules, and metadata).
• **“PHI”** (Protected Health Information) is defined in applicable U.S. law; generally it is individually identifiable health information handled in regulated contexts. See also Section 12.

---

## 3) What Docito Does (and Does Not Do)

### 3.1 Platform Services

Docito is a technology platform designed to help users:

• search and discover Providers/Facilities,
• request and manage appointments and bookings,
• communicate (messages, notifications),
• coordinate referrals,
• manage operational workflows (staff management, calendars, tasks),
• manage records and documents (notes, files, visit documentation, summaries),
• access analytics and reporting features,
• support payments/subscriptions (where enabled),
• store and manage insurance information (where enabled),
• use specialty-based UI components (e.g., dental charting for dentists).

Features may vary by region, plan, and role.

### 3.2 Not Medical Advice; No Emergency Use

Docito does **not** provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment and is not a healthcare provider. All medical services are provided by Providers/Facilities, not by Docito.

**Do not use Docito for emergencies.** If you need urgent care, call your local emergency number immediately.

### 3.3 No Guarantee of Outcomes

Docito does not guarantee medical outcomes, provider availability, appointment acceptance, insurance coverage, reimbursement, or the quality of any Provider/Facility services.

---

## 4) Global Operation

Docito operates globally. Availability of certain features, legal requirements, and compliance obligations may vary by country and region. You are responsible for using the Services in compliance with your local laws and professional obligations.

---

## 5) Accounts, Security, and Responsibility

### 5.1 Account Registration

You must provide accurate information and keep it updated. You are responsible for all activity under your account.

### 5.2 Account Security

You must safeguard your credentials and immediately notify us of unauthorized access or suspected compromise at **[support@docito.app](mailto:support@docito.app)**.

### 5.3 Role-Based Access and Staff

Providers/Facilities may invite Staff and assign permissions. You are responsible for:

• ensuring invited users are authorized,
• assigning appropriate permissions (least privilege),
• removing access promptly when no longer needed,
• ensuring your Staff comply with these Terms and applicable laws.

---

## 6) Provider and Facility Listings; Verification

### 6.1 Listings

Providers/Facilities may create listings containing profile details (specialty, services, location, hours, pricing where applicable, etc.). You must not post false or misleading information.

### 6.2 Verification (Optional / Workflow-Based)

Docito may offer verification workflows (identity checks, license details, credential uploads, affiliation confirmation, etc.). Verification may improve trust but does not guarantee clinical quality, competence, legality, or outcomes.

### 6.3 Professional Responsibility

Providers/Facilities remain solely responsible for maintaining valid licenses, credentials, approvals, and compliance with regulations in the jurisdictions where they operate.

---

## 7) Bookings, Appointments, Cancellations, and Referrals

### 7.1 Booking Requests and Confirmation

Bookings may be requests until confirmed. Providers/Facilities control availability and may accept, reject, or reschedule a Booking.

### 7.2 Cancellations and No-Shows

A Provider/Facility may enforce cancellation/no-show rules (including fees) disclosed during booking or in their policy settings (where enabled). By booking, you agree to applicable policies displayed at the time of booking.

### 7.3 Referrals

Docito may support referral workflows between Providers/Facilities. Referrals do not guarantee acceptance or appointment availability. Responsibility for clinical decisions remains with Providers/Facilities.

---

## 8) Messaging and Communications

Docito may provide in-platform messaging and notifications between users and organizations. You agree not to use messaging to:

• harass, threaten, or abuse users,
• share illegal content,
• send spam or unsolicited marketing,
• request highly sensitive information in unsafe ways.

We may limit, moderate, or disable messaging to prevent abuse and protect users.

---

## 9) Records, Notes, Files, Templates, and Exports

### 9.1 Documentation Tools

Docito may include clinical documentation and workflow tools (e.g., diagnosis → treatment → prescriptions → files → notes). Providers/Facilities are responsible for the accuracy and appropriateness of records created using Docito.

### 9.2 File Storage

You are responsible for ensuring you have the right to upload and share files and that you do not upload prohibited content.

### 9.3 Data Exports and PDFs

Docito may provide exports (e.g., summaries, PDFs). Exports are provided “as is” and should be reviewed for accuracy before use.

### 9.4 Retention

Providers/Facilities are responsible for retention requirements for medical records and operational documents as required by law and professional rules.

---

## 10) Insurance Information (If Enabled)

Docito may allow Care Seekers to store insurance details and allow Providers/Facilities to record accepted plans. Docito does not guarantee eligibility, coverage, claim approval, reimbursement, or pricing accuracy unless expressly stated in a separate written agreement.

---

## 11) Payments, Fees, Subscriptions, and Taxes (If Enabled)

### 11.1 Payment Processing

Payments may be processed through third-party payment processors. You agree to comply with their terms.

### 11.2 Fees and Plans

Docito may charge subscription fees, transaction fees, and add-on fees (e.g., storage, seats). Current pricing and plan terms are displayed in the Services. Fees are generally non-refundable unless required by law or explicitly stated.

### 11.3 Taxes

You are responsible for applicable taxes, duties, or government assessments.

---

## 12) Privacy, Security, and Health Data

### 12.1 Privacy

Our collection and use of personal data is described in our Privacy Policy.

### 12.2 Security Practices

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect data and maintain platform reliability. However, no system is perfectly secure.

### 12.3 PHI and HIPAA (U.S.)

If you are in the United States and you (or your organization) are subject to HIPAA, certain health-related data may qualify as **PHI**. Docito is not making a blanket claim of HIPAA compliance in these Terms.

If a U.S. healthcare organization requires a **Business Associate Agreement (BAA)**, such support may be available **only under a separate written agreement** and only for eligible organizations and configurations.
